title: How Red Bull Broke Formula 1 in 2023 🤯
description:
The video starts with Zak Brown and Toto Wolff being asked how they would sum up 2023, with both answering simply: "Red Bull". This unprecedented domination is further emphasized by Will Buxton's quote, "In 2023, Red Bull made everyone look stupid". The edit then transitions into a fast-paced sequence highlighting Max Verstappen's record-breaking 19 wins in a single season, along with Sergio Perez's victories, showcasing Red Bull's historic sweep of the calendar.
